caption: The drawing depicts a wooden stand or small table with an intricate design, shown against a plain, off-white background. The stand is a light brown wood color, with a flat lower shelf supported by two decorative, vertically-oriented side panels that feature curved cutout patterns. The top of the stand has an indented, curved opening at the front center, flanked by two side extensions that rise up and then slope downward with a slight outward curve. The horizontal surfaces and side panels are rendered with visible wood grain texture. The drawing is centered on the page, and beneath the stand, near the bottom right, the name "HARRY MANN WADDELL" is written in small, capital letters.
title: Prayer Bench
